name: Japan
summary: Larry remembers being in Japan around August 1965, where he personally saw a notice or article in Stars and Stripes reporting that he had been killed in action. Why he was in Japan, where exactly, and the documentation behind the erroneous report are all open research questions.
larrysRecollection: Around August 1965, Larry was in Japan. He personally remembers seeing a notice or article in Stars and Stripes saying he had been killed.
researchNotes: Research goals: locate the original Stars and Stripes item, any correction, Army casualty documentation, morning reports, and personnel records; identify any incident involving someone with a similar name; and establish why Larry was in Japan (leave, medical, transit). Captain "Guegler" may be associated with this period. No specific location within Japan is known, so no coordinates are recorded.
